answer: Epoch-seed honeypots. Each epoch a random beacon seeds a handful of thin review panels with trap prompts whose correct answer branches on that seed. A single inference pipeline wearing many masks reasons from one shared vertex, so all its identities drift down the same river of seed-specific tells, converging where honest independent agents diverge. To escape the pattern the attacker must run genuinely separate models per mask, multiplying compute and GPU hours until one-mind-many-masks stops paying.
